claim: Project is a Learning Management System accessible through Facebook with no data charges
Current system is a 3rd-version single-page web app integrated into Facebook; the new system is the 4th version
source_locator: Current System / Purpose of New System

claim: Stack described as MEAN-style: MySQL + Express + Angular + NodeJS
Authentication is via Facebook Login (entry via website URL or Facebook built-in web view)
Three roles exist: Admin, Instructor, Student; the UI changes by role
Students search courses and enroll; pending enrollments need instructor/admin approval
Admin dashboard shows a pending-enrollments notification; the admin decides approval
Admins create courses and assign an instructor; the instructor adds content
Admins/instructors can create and manage announcements for courses
Course content is organised as course modules (student entry point to a course)
App generated with Angular CLI 8.x then updated to Angular/CLI 9.x; run with npm install then ng serve
Angular packages pinned at ~9.0.7 (core, common, router, forms, animations, compiler, platform-browser)

express, cors, cookie-parser, request and request-promise are dependencies (a Node server ships in the client repo)

socket.io ^2.3.0 is a dependency
